title: Large context output
use_case: Demonstrate the context-output spill threshold with bounded synthetic text.
action: Launch a new session and ask: Read the startup reference preview and state its topic briefly without tools.
evidence: The hook returns 40 bounded synthetic reference lines; with additionalContextLimit 64, Codex should provide a shortened preview and saved-file reference.
caveat: The limit is approximate tokens, not bytes. Fixture playback verifies the text only; spilling and file references require live CLI delivery. Do not put secrets in hook output.
